payload.title: Gluon Tutorial 07: Persistent Kernels and Pipeline Optimization
payload.summary: This tutorial covers building a unified MMA abstraction layer across Hopper and Blackwell, implementing pipelined matrix multiplication, persistent kernel design with tile schedulers, and outer-loop pipeline optimization using the STEALB buffer-borrowing technique.

sections.heading: 1. Unified MMA Abstraction Layer
sections.gist: To support both Hopper (WGMMA) and Blackwell (tcgen05_mma) with a single kernel, a unified abstraction is built using Gluon's `@aggregate` decorator.

sections.heading: 2. Pipelined Matrix Multiplication
sections.gist: The kernel pipelines both loads and MMA operations using multiple buffers.

sections.heading: 3. Persistent Kernel Implementation
sections.gist: A persistent kernel wraps the computation in an outer loop, processing multiple tiles per program.
